milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Produce current release evidence and establish whether version 1.1.1 can pass trusted internal production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Bound the complete audit pipeline to one UUID auditRunId and immutable content-addressed evidence, including Gitleaks, schema 2.2 findings/review, schema 2.1 remediation plans, schema 3.1 execution, detailed verification records, and cross-artifact digest validation.

decisions.decision: Use caller-supplied or generated UUID audit run identity.
decisions.rationale: One opaque identifier binds all evidence without leaking project or workstation names.
Findings can prove the exact collector output they consumed and reject tampering or unrelated evidence.

decisions.decision: Advance current schemas while retaining historical readability.
decisions.rationale: Run binding is mandatory for new assurance without rewriting accepted legacy artifacts.
Planning and local validation do not satisfy trusted signing, independent review, artifact health, revocation, or production-verification gates.

validation.evidence: Findings, review, remediation plan, and execution accept one shared auditRunId and reject mismatched identities or digests.
Collector snapshots are content-addressed, digest-verified, report-safe, and cleaned after tests.
Thirty-five tests passed with one platform-specific skip; four dedicated Gitleaks tests passed with one symlink skip.
All four audit pipeline skills expose current run-binding requirements in generated help.
All 45 skills passed inventory audit; Project Understanding and the canonical project guide rebuilt and validated.
Final npm run check passed 133 of 134 tests with one platform-specific skip, scanned 221 files, verified 161 unsigned candidate files, and verified all 45 skills.
Operational artifact health and revocation, trusted signature, distinct independent review, and production verification remain blocked.

worktree.attribution: All current changes belong to the approved workflow-planner and four-skill run-bound audit pipeline updates, schemas, validators, tests, generated documentation and evidence, corrected P4 plan lineage, and synchronized continuity.

blockers: AUD-0205 production release assurance remains unresolved.
Trusted signing and distinct independent-review identities are absent.
No restricted internal artifact destination, installation-health signal, or tested revocation operation exists.
Required human source review awaits a second qualified collaborator.
Azure Government publication readiness remains blocked wherever current service, channel, authorization, or data-boundary availability is unknown.
pendingApprovals: Trusted signing by a controlled identity and independent review by a distinct qualified reviewer remain required.
Any further commit or push requires new explicit approval.

Pull request creation, merge, release, Foundry agent creation or endpoint mutation, Bot Service creation, Microsoft 365 or Teams publication, Custom GPT creation or sharing, GPT Action configuration, deployment, and MCP installation each require separate approval.
limitations: Legacy audit artifacts remain readable but only current run-bound schema versions can establish current assurance.
The 24-hour freshness policy is local policy and may need a shorter organization-specific threshold for high-risk audits.
Standards lastVerifiedAt remains null until an approved audit performs authoritative-source retrieval.
Supplemental scanner availability is reported but does not satisfy required pinned Gitleaks readiness or completion.
Tracked reports and untracked distributable files share the worktree findings bucket because one directory scan covers both current-file scopes.
Standards catalog entries are candidates only; every audit must resolve current lifecycle and version evidence from authoritative sources.
Schema 1.0 and 2.0 audit artifacts remain readable historical evidence but cannot establish current schema 2.1 assurance.
Conditional AI and agentic profiles require repository-specific applicability assessment before they affect assurance.
Legacy schema 1.0 workflow plans remain readable but do not provide schema 1.1 execution guarantees.
The focused suite does not exercise simultaneous lock contention between two live apply processes.
No live Foundry endpoint, Microsoft 365 or Teams channel, Bot Service resource, Custom GPT, or GPT Action was created or exercised.
No signing, release, publication, deployment, hosted-agent creation, MCP installation, or Azure mutation is authorized by this handoff.

nextAction.action: Execute STEP-001 of reports/workflow-plan.json to reconstruct the stale P4 execution timeline and select a safe restart, resume, or replan route.
prerequisites: Read reports/current-execution-state.json, reports/execution-log.jsonl, reports/audit-remediation-execution.json, and the immutable P4 plan snapshot.
Perform read-only recovery analysis; do not resume remediation or mutate external systems.
